title: Do not rely on SessionStart stdout for injection
trigger: when injecting SuperMem via SessionStart stdout
behavior_delta: Do not treat SessionStart stdout as the injection path on Grok. Call supermem_retrieve, or the UserPromptSubmit hook.
what: Grok ignores SessionStart stdout. If the model never retrieves, cost is 0 and so is value.
why: A perfect hot path unused is a dead plugin.

retrieval_forms.micro: Do not rely on SessionStart stdout.
retrieval_forms.short: Grok ignores SessionStart stdout. Call supermem_retrieve before the action.
